d: Malaysia has been a favourite destination for Indian tourists, thanks to its visa-free entry facility introduced in late 2023. But that convenience is coming to an end. From January 1, 2027, Indian passport holders will need a visa before travelling to the country. Meanwhile, Did Iran cut Pakistan's internet cables? Internet services across parts of Pakistan were disrupted after a fault was reported in the SMW5 international submarine cable system, around 11 kilometres off Pakistan's coast.
